subject: W2.b micro-drill: write acceptance criteria now
body:
GF — go ahead and write the W2.b micro-drill acceptance criteria. No need to wait further.

Context:
- W2.b is Kai's most-tested standard: 6 exams, 100% LOCKED.
- A micro-drill (5-question intercepts set) would add targeted practice for the specific sub-skill of finding x-intercepts by function type.
- GR is the one who would build the content. Your acceptance criteria will give GR a verifiable target.

Suggested acceptance criteria shape:
  - 5 questions, each a different parent function type (exponential, quadratic, absolute-value, rational, radical)
  - Each question: one numeric input, answer unique across W2.b drill and all 10 retake-practice exams
  - feedback_correct <= 12 words, feedback_wrong <= 15 words
  - All 5 pass node tests/verify-practice-exams.js contract checks
  - No duplicate signatures with existing W2.b questions (cross-exam-verify.js PASS)

If you write a QA contract file, route it to GR's inbox so they know what they're building toward.

GI will wire the drill into concept-coverage.cjs once it ships (so the tool tracks W2.b drill coverage separately from retake exams).

— GI
